open.description: The controlled open state of the tooltip

default-open.description:
The initial open state of the tooltip when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the tooltip.

open-delay.description: The open delay of the tooltip.

close-delay.description: The close delay of the tooltip.

interactive.description:
Whether the tooltip's content is interactive.
In this mode, the tooltip will remain open when user hovers over the content.

close-on-click.description: Whether the tooltip should close on click

placement.description: The placement of the floating element relative to its anchor.

gutter.description: The gap between the floating element and its anchor.

same-width.description: Whether the floating element matches the width of its anchor.

skip-animation-on-mount.description: Whether to allow the initial presence animation.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.
